review_basis: Preliminary evidence (M3B-1 authoritative-recovery investigation, M3B-2A AI-assisted preliminary visual review of 50 sampled groups, and pHash pairwise-distance analysis) was presented to the user; the approvals recorded in this file are the user's explicit, final decisions -- not a continuation of the preliminary_ai_review process itself.
singleton_fallback_forbidden: Explicit policy: an unmatched/unresolved image is NEVER treated as a safe singleton group merely because no grouping evidence connects it to another image. Absence of evidence is not evidence of a unique leaf. Any image without an approved leaf_id, an approved filename-family group, or an approved pHash cluster remains quarantined -- it is never silently assigned its own one-image group to let it into a split.
unresolved_images_remain_quarantined: Explicit policy: any image not covered by an approved grouping mechanism (authoritative leaf_id, an approved filename-family rule, or an approved pHash cluster) stays quarantined by default and is excluded from train/validation/test eligibility until a future, separate approval resolves it.

tomato_healthy.normalization: Strip a leading <uuid>___ prefix if present, strip the final .jpg/.jpeg extension, match case-insensitively.
tomato_healthy.grouping_key: th::Leaf<N> (decimal sub-index folded into the same group)
quarantined_filenames_excluded_from_rule: CG1.JPG (unrelated naming convention, not GH_HL family)

tomato_late_blight.normalization: Strip a leading <uuid>___ prefix if present, strip the final .jpg/.jpeg extension, match case-insensitively; session prefix matched longest-first (GHLB2ES/GHLB2/GHLB_PS before GHLB).
tomato_late_blight.grouping_key: tlb::<session_prefix>::Leaf<N> (decimal sub-index AND Day number both folded into the same group; session prefix always kept separate -- confirmed 109 cases of a leaf number shared across different prefixes remain distinct groups)

large_groups.decision_basis: Individually presented to the user with: full member filenames, Day/sub-index breakdown, preliminary_ai_review judgment, contact-sheet location, and newly-computed pairwise pHash Hamming distances (max 34-46 out of 64 -- no pixel-hash corroboration, grouping rests on filename metadata + preliminary AI visual review only).

tomato_early_blight.reason: Only 1 unmatched image exists -- a single image cannot demonstrate a filename family.

covered_by_stronger_grouping_uncondition.reason: Potato Early Blight x2 and Potato Late Blight x1 -- both members of each pair already have an authoritative leaf_id match; no separate pHash approval required.

covered_by_stronger_grouping_conditional.reason: Tomato Healthy x7, Tomato Late Blight x1 -- both members of each pair already fall under the same approved th::/tlb:: filename-family group key (now approved above); no separate pHash approval required.
